# poomsae

> poomsae is a local-first, open-source issue tracker for coding agents and the
> humans steering them. A daemon on your own machine answers queries in about
> 4ms, agents coordinate and hand off work through the ledger, and a TUI and
> browser UI supervise the same data.

The product and guide pages have exact Markdown twins; documentation pages are
served as HTML with Markdown twins alongside. Markdown versions are canonical
for machine readers.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/index.md): what poomsae is; speed,
  memory, coordination, discipline, supervision, interfaces, sync, reach
- [The poomsae guide](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/guide.md): the nine-move operating
  loop of bind, seed, claim, note, coordinate, close, supervise, sync, own

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/index.md): overview and
  quickstart
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/get-started/quickstart.md): install
  to first close
- [Install](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/get-started/install.md): all install
  options
- [Concepts](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/concepts.md): projects,
  workspaces, issue identity, events, close discipline
- [Agent workflows](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/workflows/agents.md): the
  operating contract for coding agents
- [Agent orchestration](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/agent-orchestration.md):
  fan-out/join, attention hooks, dashboards
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/cli.md): every command
  and flag
- [MCP reference](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/mcp.md): stdio and
  Streamable HTTP transports, tool loading
- [MCP Events webhooks](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/mcp-events.md):
  daemon-owned signed inbox wakes, subscriptions, keys and recovery
- [Agent output format](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/agent-output.md):
  the `--agent` output contract
- [Go client](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/go-client.md): typed Go
  client, daemon discovery, and an in-process test server
- [Web UI](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/web-ui.md): the browser workspace
- [Issue attachments](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/attachments.md):
  Docbank file attachments, image and video previews, and close evidence
- [Semantic search](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/semantic-search.md):
  opt-in embeddings
- [Gated workflows](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/workflows/gated-workflows.md):
  ordered issue stages, human approval, evidence, and attention.
- [Sharing models](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/workflows/sharing.md): local,
  private network, federation, hosted
- [Share projects between hubs](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/project-relays.md):
  relay setup, daemon selection, credentials, sync status and recovery
- [Federation](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/federation.md):
  operator reference for replication, account credentials, team access and recovery
- [HTTP API](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/http-api.md):
  request contracts, project access, concurrent changes and relay enrollment
- [Forgejo connector](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/forgejo-connector.md):
  Bind Forgejo issues through the built-in Go connector.
- [GitHub sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/github-sync.md):
  mirror upstream issues into poomsae
- [Notion sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/notion-sync.md):
  mirror one task data source with daemon polling and optional two-way status sync
- [Configuration](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/configuration.md):
  config.toml reference
- [Cron](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/reference/cron.md):
  shared job definitions, run evidence, and recurring child issues
- [Cron failure alerts](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/cron-failure-alerts.md):
  notify an inbox recipient about failed or unknown runs
- [Diagnosing setup](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/doctor.md):
  read-only configuration, daemon, project and hook diagnostics with `poomsae doctor`
- [Backup and restore](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/backup-restore.md):
  JSONL export and import
- [Containers](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/containers.md):
  stock images, environment settings, mounted secrets, and persistent storage
- [Architecture](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/design/architecture.md): design
  notes
- [Comparisons](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/guide/comparisons.md): poomsae vs.
  SaaS issue trackers

## Other

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae): source, issues,
  releases
- [Changelog](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/changelog.md): release history

- [Local daemon profiles](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/local-daemon-profiles.md):
  Pin personal/work homes and recover existing spokes without changing routing.

- [Plane sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/plane-sync.md): Mirror a Plane project with daemon-owned API credentials and optional two-way status sync.
- [Linear sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/linear-sync.md): Scope, credentials, field ownership, status synchronization, and recovery.
- [Twenty sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/twenty-sync.md): Mirror Twenty workspace tasks with self-hosted support and optional two-way status sync.
- [Todoist sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/todoist-sync.md): Scoped task import, status writeback, field ownership, and recovery.
- [TickTick sync](https://github.com/ifigueroap/poomsae/docs/operations/ticktick-sync.md): Import one task project and write ordinary completion back through the public API.
